test.create_query: CREATE TABLE tab ( id UInt64, name String, INDEX idx(name) TYPE text(tokenizer = array) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO tab SELECT number, if(number % 1000 = 0, concat('alpha-service-', toString(number), '-prod'), concat('beta-service-', toString(number), '-dev')) FROM numbers(10000000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE name LIKE '%service-4000-%'
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE name LIKE 'alpha-service-4000%'
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE name LIKE '%service-4000-prod'
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE name LIKE '%alpha%4000%prod%'
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE name LIKE 'alpha-service-4000-pro_'
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE name LIKE 'alpha-service-4000-prod'
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE name ILIKE '%SERVICE-4000-PROD'
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE startsWith(name, 'alpha-service-4000')
SELECT count() FROM tab WHERE endsWith(name, 'service-4000-prod')
